name: zsh-wordsplit-guard
description: Denies a Bash command looping over a bare expansion (`for x in $var`): the Bash tool runs zsh, where parameter expansion is not word-split, so the loop silently runs once over the whole string instead of per element. A glob or a path around the expansion (`for f in $D/*.log`) is left alone. The deny message names the splitting forms to use instead. Opt out per call with `[nosplit]` in the description, or session-wide with ALLOW_ZSH_NOSPLIT=1.
